summary: Backend + frontend end-to-end testing for Amber Cove marketing site. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (root, POST /api/contact valid, list ordering (desc by created_at), missing fields 422, invalid email 422, optional-defaults). Frontend: 24/24 Playwright checks pass — hero CTAs, all 5 nav links, 6 service cards, 5 portfolio items with loaded images, testimonials next/prev, contact-form empty-validation (shows sonner error toast, no POST), and valid submission (real POST /api/contact fires, success toast shown, form cleared).

issues: Lenis console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' — cosmetic, does not affect behavior.

action_items: Optional: Fix Lenis container position warning by setting position: relative on the wrapper element.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes EMAIL_BASE_URL and reads required env vars at import time — acceptable, but consider graceful fallback if EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY missing (currently would KeyError at boot).
GET /api/contact uses .to_list(1000) with no pagination — fine for now but note for scale.
seed_data_creation: Test contacts prefixed with TEST_ inserted via API during tests. Cleanup fixture attempts local Mongo delete; note preview backend may use a remote DB so a few TEST_-prefixed rows may persist there.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All specified data-testids exist and work. Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL responds; POST/GET /api/contact both healthy. When running pytest, xdist load balancing can cause the list-ordering assertion to be brittle if two workers hit the same class — current test asserts presence (not first position) and passes cleanly in both modes.
